title: Campus access & external proxy
description: Choose how to access campus resources. Google and other external sites keep using your existing Clash proxy.
network_available: Campus resources are reachable directly. School VPN is optional.
network_unavailable: Direct campus access is unavailable. Connect school VPN for off-campus access.
direct_option: Use direct access (do not start school VPN)
connect_option: Connect school VPN for off-campus access
not_installed: zju-connect is not installed. Download it for off-campus access, or continue with direct access.
saved_account_hint: Leave the password empty to use your saved account. New credentials are encrypted for this Windows user.
direct_normal: Direct access without school VPN is a normal choice on campus.
download_progress: Downloading zju-connect {0} from its upstream GitHub release...
download_start_failed: The download could not start. Check your Internet connection and try again.
download_complete: Download complete. Select Connect school VPN and enter your ZJU account when needed.
download_failed: The download did not complete or could not be verified. You can retry or use direct access.
account_required: Enter your ZJU account before connecting.
credentials_required: Enter your ZJU account and password, then select Connect school VPN.
routing_preparing: Preparing Clash routing. This may take a few seconds...
routing_start_failed: The routing task could not start. Please retry; diagnostic details are saved locally.
routing_failed: The routing task did not complete. Please retry or check the local startup log for the reason.
routing_ready_direct: Routing is ready. No new school VPN connection was started. Press Enter or Close to exit.
routing_finishing: Finishing routing setup. You can close the window when this step completes.
vpn_connecting: Connecting school VPN. Complete any verification that opens in your browser.
vpn_connection_ended: The connection ended. Check your account and try again, or use direct access.
operation_failed: This step could not finish. You can try again or close the window.
code_invalid: Enter the verification code shown in your school message.
window_already_open: The zju-vpn window is already open.
window_open_failed: The startup window could not open. Check your installation or use scripts/start.ps1 for diagnostics.
vpn_already_connected: School VPN is already connected. You can close this window.
vpn_session_busy: Another VPN connection is being managed. Close the pending connection window and try again.
vpn_authenticating: Connecting. Complete any verification that opens in your browser.
vpn_cancelled: Connection cancelled. Direct routing remains available.
vpn_connected: School VPN is connected. You can close this window; it will keep running.
vpn_code_required: Enter the verification code requested by the school VPN.
vpn_code_submitted: Verification submitted. Waiting for the school VPN.
vpn_stopped: The school VPN stopped. Check your account or try connecting again.
vpn_failed: Could not connect to school VPN. Check your account and retry; private diagnostics are saved.
routing_result_unknown: The background task result could not be confirmed. Please retry; this does not mean Clash is missing.
